snippet.title: Avatars on the edge (5/4/2013)
snippet.description:
Official description: Come on! Grab your board and challenge gravity! Jump from the roof of the buildings performing crazy stunts. Surpass yourself on twelve timetrials or challenge your friends online. Feel the wind on your face and laugh at danger to get your name to the top of the scoreboards.

RELEASE DATE: 5/4/2013
DEVELOPER: mancebo
GENRE: Racing & Flying
Offline players 1 - 2
System Link 2 - 4
Online multiplayer 2 - 4
